descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S08 Custom template: the type list is the pilot types plus Procedure / other, the type drives the family exactly like the stock template, and 'Procedure / other' gets no billing (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Creating a custom template requires a note-type selection (one of the 8 pilot templates or 'Procedure / other'); the template cannot be saved without one (step 3). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92599 AC 8; TFA-92599 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U9 A custom template's type drives the billing family exactly like the stock template of that type; 'Procedure / other' gets no billing. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 What (custom template row); TFA-92599 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U7 Discharge (Hospital 99238 / 99239, SNF 99315 / 99316): if the time is in the note, the code is set from it (<= 30 min -> 99238 / 99315, > 30 min -> 99239 / 99316); … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 5; TFA-92596 What (SNF discharge new family)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Settings -> Note Templates -> New in each context; custom templates of type SOAP progress, H&P, Procedure / other, Discharge summary (Hospital) and SNF follow-up, Procedure / other, SNF discharge (Nursing Home); each leg its own case with a fresh session

When Open the type field and list its options; then create one template per leg, Generate one note with it and open Post-Round

Then The type options are the pilot types plus Procedure / other, with no Handoff, Clinic or removed prototype templates; SOAP progress type -> 99231-99233; H&P type -> 99221-99223; SNF follow-up type -> 99307-99310; Discharge summary / SNF discharge type with no time -> the <= 30 / > 30 prompt and no code; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint: options checkpoints mustContain the types and optionsMustNotContain the excluded ones (inside the type field's option list only: the page behind the modal can show 'Handoff'); the Hospital list of all 8 types is Q11. Typed templates: mustContainAny the type's family, mustNotContain the rest and the no-result texts, billingCard checks. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
